reason: I don't take most supplements unless a doctor says to, and I already forget the vitamins on my counter half the time. A named lab report is better than most, but I don't have a reason to start magnesium.
objection: Nobody has told me I'm low on magnesium, so I'd be paying monthly for something I'd forget to take. A lab report only shows what's in the capsule, not that I need it.
would_change_my_mind: My doctor recommending magnesium for me, or a blood test showing I'm low.
